##### Project general facts

Altia One by YAS Developers is a modern residential development crafted as a sanctuary where every aspect of life is elevated to new levels of harmony and satisfaction. It features a curated selection of one-, two- and three-bedroom residences in a mid-rise building with a rooftop, merging comfort and functionality through a seamless fusion of innovative design and architectural craftsmanship.

Residents are welcomed into a thoughtfully designed lifestyle, with recreational amenities that support well-being and build a vibrant community. Social spaces celebrate community spirit, eco-friendly features embrace sustainable living, and an open-sky rooftop sitting area offers a serene retreat where comfort meets refined style.

Every residence combines modern sophistication with purposeful design and a seamless integration of living spaces. One-bedroom apartments feature fully fitted kitchens, open-plan living and dining areas, ensuite showers and private balconies. Two-bedroom apartments offer bedrooms with ample storage, minimalist bathrooms and open living areas, while three-bedroom apartments provide ensuite bathrooms, open living rooms and fully equipped kitchens with open or closed layout options. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished, with adaptable spaces and panoramic views.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a vibrant community that offers a seamless blend of connectivity, comfort and modern living. Public transportation networks run throughout the area, and strategic access to major thoroughfares makes travel across Dubai convenient and hassle-free.

The community is distinguished by a wide choice of restaurants, cafés and retail options, giving residents effortless access to everyday essentials and leisure. Its well-integrated layout combines comfort with convenience in a distinguished setting.

Dubai Silicon Oasis combines innovation, convenience and a well-connected address, making it a popular choice for professionals, families and investors seeking steady rental demand in Dubai.
